notes.subject: השע ממני
notes.rationale: 'Shefa kgakala le nna' (JPS/BSB) kgathanong le 'nkatola' (KJV/ASV) — šupišo ya go shefa ka tshepo ya thušo goba ya kotlo

notes.subject: ואבליגה
notes.rationale: Lentšu le hlalosa go ikantsha/go phologa; 'ke nwe' e hlahlama go phumula ga pelo, e sego tlhalo ya sela

notes.subject: to Yahwe
notes.rationale: Boikokobetši bja mafelelo bja thapelo, bo lebišitšwe go Yahwe

translation: O sefishe mahlo ⟨a gago⟩ go tšwa go nna, gore ke nwe, pele ga ke sepela ke siye gomme ke se sa lego gona.

tokens.gloss: gomme ke se sa lego gona
